dataset_title: Maharashtra Government Websites and Digital Portals
source: Integrated Government Online Directory (IGOD), Government of India / NIC
scope_note: This file contains records collected from the Maharashtra categories exposed by IGOD during this research pass. IGOD currently reports 42 departments, 24 directorates/commissionerates, 38 boards/undertakings, 7 statutory/autonomous bodies, 7 PSUs/JVs/companies/societies, 55 academies/institutions, 18 schemes/programmes/missions/applications, 71 others, and 36 districts. Some IGOD entries do not expose a separate URL; these are retained with url=null rather than inventing a link.
